mapper.insert: WITH soft_delete_rows AS ( UPDATE "MP_IPMS_PA".utb_duedate_mst SET del_yn = 'Y', update_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, update_user = #{updateUser} WHERE office_seq = #{officeSeq} AND del_yn = 'N' AND duedate_category_code = #{duedateCategoryCode} AND duedate_seq IN (SELECT duedate_seq FROM "MP_IPMS_PA".utb_duedate_mapp WHERE tbl_seq = #{tblSeq} AND office_seq = #{officeSeq} AND del_yn = 'N') RETURNING duedate_seq ) INSERT INTO "MP_IPMS_PA".utb_duedate_mst ( duedate_seq, duedate_order, office_seq, duedate_date, duedate_kind_code, duedate_category_code, create_user, del_yn, create_at ) SELECT duedate_seq, nextval('utb_duedate_mst_order_seq'), #{officeSeq}, #{duedateDate}, #{duedateKindCode}, #{duedateCategoryCode}, #{createUser}, 'N', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM soft_delete_rows;
mapper.update: UPDATE "MP_IPMS_PA".utb_duedate_mst SET duedate_date = #{duedateDate}, update_user = #{updateUser}, update_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE duedate_seq = #{duedateSeq} AND del_yn = 'N'

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT am.app_seq AS "appSeq", '' AS "conflictSeq", am.app_classification AS "appClassification", 'N' AS "etcYn", fn_get_cd_nm('NAT_IO_DIV', am.app_classification) AS "caseCategoryName", fn_get_cd_nm('TARGET_TYPE', p.target_code) AS "progressTypeName", am.right_category AS "rightTypeCode", fn_get_cd_nm('PAT_TYPE', am.right_category) AS "rightTypeName", am.asset_no AS "ourRef", to_char(due."appDate", 'YYYYMMDD') AS "appDate", am.app_no AS "appNo", to_char(due."regDate", 'YYYYMMDD') AS "regDate", am.reg_no AS "regNo", am.product_class AS "productClass", to_char(pdue."documentSubmitDate", 'YYYYMMDD') AS "documentSubmitDate", to_char(pdue."oaDeliveryDate", 'YYYYMMDD') AS "oaDeliveryDate", to_char(pdue."receiptDate", 'YYYYMMDD') AS "receiptDate", to_char(p.create_at, 'YYYYMMDD') AS "eventDate", COALESCE(p.receipt_doc_content, fn_get_doc_nm(p.receipt_doc_seq)) AS "content", pp."applicant_NM" AS "applicantName", am.app_name_ko AS "titleKo", p.create_at AS "sortDate" /* am.* 제거 (컬럼 개수 불일치 원인) */ FROM utb_progress p INNER JOIN utb_app_mst am ON p.tbl_seq = am.app_seq AND p.office_seq = am.office_seq LEFT JOIN v_total_duedate_pivot due ON am.app_seq = due.tbl_seq AND am.office_seq = due.office_seq LEFT JOIN v_total_duedate_pivot pdue ON p.progress_seq = pdue.tbl_seq AND p.office_seq = pdue.office_seq LEFT JOIN v_participant_pivot pp ON am.app_seq = pp.tbl_seq AND am.office_seq = pp.office_seq WHERE p.office_seq = #{request.officeSeq} AND p.del_yn = 'N' AND p.tbl_seq LIKE 'APPMST%'
UNION ALL
SELECT cm.app_seq AS "appSeq", cm.conflict_seq AS "conflictSeq", 'CFT' AS "appClassification", cm.etc_yn AS "etcYn", fn_get_cd_nm('NAT_IO_DIV', am.app_classification) AS "caseCategoryName", fn_get_cd_nm('TARGET_TYPE', p.target_code) AS "progressTypeName", am.right_category AS "rightTypeCode", fn_get_cd_nm('PAT_TYPE', am.right_category) AS "rightTypeName", cm.asset_no AS "ourRef", to_char(due."appDate", 'YYYYMMDD') AS "appDate", am.app_no AS "appNo", to_char(due."regDate", 'YYYYMMDD') AS "regDate", am.reg_no AS "regNo", am.product_class AS "productClass", to_char(pdue."documentSubmitDate", 'YYYYMMDD') AS "documentSubmitDate", to_char(pdue."oaDeliveryDate", 'YYYYMMDD') AS "oaDeliveryDate", to_char(pdue."receiptDate", 'YYYYMMDD') AS "receiptDate", to_char(p.create_at, 'YYYYMMDD') AS "eventDate", COALESCE(p.receipt_doc_content, fn_get_doc_nm(p.receipt_doc_seq)) AS "content", pp."applicant_NM" AS "applicantName", am.app_name_ko AS "titleKo", p.create_at AS "sortDate" /* cm.* 제거 (컬럼 개수 불일치 원인) */ FROM utb_progress p INNER JOIN utb_conflict_mst cm ON p.tbl_seq = cm.conflict_seq AND p.office_seq = cm.office_seq INNER JOIN utb_app_mst am ON cm.app_seq = am.app_seq AND cm.office_seq = am.office_seq LEFT JOIN v_total_duedate_pivot due ON am.app_seq = due.tbl_seq AND am.office_seq = due.office_seq LEFT JOIN v_total_duedate_pivot pdue ON p.progress_seq = pdue.tbl_seq AND p.office_seq = pdue.office_seq LEFT JOIN v_participant_pivot pp ON am.app_seq = pp.tbl_seq AND am.office_seq = pp.office_seq WHERE p.office_seq = #{request.officeSeq} AND p.del_yn = 'N' AND p.tbl_seq LIKE 'CFTMST%' ) AS combined WHERE 1=1
ORDER BY "sortDate" DESC LIMIT #{request.pageSize} OFFSET #{request.offSet}
